entries.title: Fixed Platform Poise-Beam Parcel Scale
entries.description: One complete original fixed mechanical parcel-scale appearance: low broad platform on a ground frame, independent rear column with transverse fulcrum, unequal-arm beam, genuinely bored rectangular poise, short-arm counterweight, lower and vertical transfer links, and an open index frame. No old electronic scale, two-pan balance or crossed lift geometry imported. Raised index ticks are non-calibrated visual marks. One static model, zero scenes; no weighing, accuracy, calibration, motion, equilibrium, capacity, manufacturing, load or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Internal Ring Planetary Display
entries.description: One newly authored complete static planetary-layout display. A full vertical internally toothed annulus is grounded by two broad roots on a single bed. One central external-tooth sun and three separate external-tooth wheels occupy the same plane inside that ring. Every gear has continuous integral tooth flanks and a real axial bore. A complete rear three-arm carrier fixes the three offset pins; whole front retainers and rear spacers support each wheel. A central coaxial shaft and a separate grounded bored rear pedestal complete the apparatus. The new internal-tooth enclosure and common-axis carrier with parallel offset planet axes differ from the old two fixed parallel spur shafts, perpendicular worm/wheel or transverse four-cone differential. All whole numeric geometry is new, not a count change or rearrangement of imported gear meshes. Three opaque constant PBR roles, closed editable components, metres, Z up and whole horizontal bounds-centred bed. One whole model, zero scenes. Deliberate finite envelope gaps between sun, planets and ring teeth make this a fixed illustrative layout only, not a meshed functioning epicyclic transmission. No involute accuracy, orbit, rotation, gear ratio, torque, bearing fit, power, lubrication, manufacture, load or equipment safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Open Cross-Frame Dish Rack
entries.description: One original complete fixed-open cross-frame wooden dish-rack appearance. Two width-offset pairs of full diagonal end rails form actual X silhouettes and connect through transverse pins. A high rear slatted deck and lower opposing front slatted deck form an open V cradle with real gaps between every full-width wooden slat; four short foot pads meet the ground. Entire new whole numeric geometry, not the old catch-tray/vertical-loop rack or the flat-centre/outward-wing laundry rack resized. Three opaque constant PBR materials, no dishes, water, catch tray or textures. One whole prop, zero scenes. Only the displayed static pose: no folding sweep, actual hinge mechanics, drainage simulation, plate compatibility/capacity, load, food hygiene, manufacture, stability or safety certification.
